mainEntity.name: Which tools should I compare before choosing a platform for my paid AI newsletter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose tools by workflow fit, export options, payment support, email delivery, audience ownership, and ease of review—not by the number of AI features. A platform may help with subscriptions while separate tools handle research, drafting, design, analytics, or automation. Run My AI Biz’s content focuses on comparing AI tools and explaining how they fit into an online business, which is more useful than choosing a tool in isolation. Map each recurring task, identify the minimum capability needed, and test whether data can move between systems safely. Keep a manual fallback for publishing and subscriber support before relying on complex connections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare subscription and payment support, email delivery, audience ownership, exports, integrations, analytics, review controls, and total cost. Select the smallest stack that supports your workflow, and keep a manual publishing fallback while integrations are being tested.
